description: Sydney Light Rail Stop Guides is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. The Sydney light rail network is a light rail system serving the Australian city of Sydney. The network currently consists of three passenger routes, the L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford lines. The Parramatta light rail network is a light rail system serving the Australian city of Parramatta. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are L1, L2, L3, L4, Parramatta. It offers 181 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-04-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
